@graph.headline: Social Media Marketing for Home Builders
@graph.description: Plan social media marketing for home builders around job-site expertise, project proof, permissions, accessible production, and a useful content capture rhythm.

mainEntity.name: What should home builders post on social media?

acceptedAnswer.text: Post useful, approved explanations of materials, process, progress, people, buyer questions, and project decisions. Pair strong visuals with context that shows judgment, not only a finished-room gallery.

mainEntity.name: How often should a home builder post?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a cadence the team can sustain with accurate, permission-cleared work. Consistency matters less than publishing useful content safely and responding responsibly to the audience.

mainEntity.name: Do home builders need permission to show a project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The team should obtain the required permission before showing identifiable homes, people, addresses, plans, testimonials, or private project details. The exact release and legal requirements depend on the use and jurisdiction.

mainEntity.name: How should social media leads be measured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Track the source and the action, then reconcile the inquiry with CRM status and sales feedback. A view, reaction, follower, or platform event does not by itself prove a qualified lead or project.
